description: P0-7 (PRIORITY-0.md): every durable boundary the code has (scripts/durable-boundaries.mjs finds them) and the tests that kill, retry or restart right after it and check that what was made durable means what it meant. Generated owners are checked against the code; a new boundary without an entry fails the gate.
